fusions.name: Masthead Sighting
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 9 tiles away for 26 damage, rising to 2.2 times that at full reach. It always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Figurehead Stare
fusions.desc: Sends a stare at the first enemy it meets for 4 damage, with a 40% chance to leave it [Leaden] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Landfall at a Glance
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a spot you can see up to 7 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Pricked on the Chart
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying one of your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage and have 6% more dodge chance.
